LEU.note: Sole US-owned enricher; $900M fixed-price DOE HALEU contract (2026-06-30) + $2.4B LEU backlog. The purest bottleneck in the theme.

CCJ.note: Theme blue chip: tier-1 pounds, UF6 conversion scarcity, and reactor-services exposure in one balance sheet.

UEC.note: Largest US-listed pure-play miner; unhedged spot leverage; ramping Wyoming/Texas ISR hubs. Most substitutable pounds in the stack.

UUUU.note: White Mesa is the only operating conventional US uranium mill; rare-earth line dilutes purity but adds policy support.

NXE.note: Speculative: world-class undeveloped deposit; licensing timeline has slipped. Optionality, not cash flow.

BWXT.note: Sole-source naval reactor manufacturer; building the RPV for Darlington's first BWRX-300; TRISO/HALEU fuel work. Decades of NRC/Navy qualification.

GEV.note: BWRX-300 is the West's lead SMR order book (Darlington x4, TVA Clinch River, Poland, Sweden); nuclear is a slice of a big company.

CW.note: Legacy sole-source content across the operating fleet + AP1000; every restart and uprate is aftermarket revenue.

MIR.note: Every reactor, restart, and fuel facility needs dosimetry/monitoring; recurring, design-agnostic demand.

CEG.sub: Largest US nuclear fleet + Crane restart
CEG.note: Microsoft 837 MW / 20-yr (Crane, 2027 restart) + Meta 1.1 GW / 20-yr (Clinton); the restart-execution flagship.

TLN.note: Amazon 1.92 GW / 17-yr PPA; the most concentrated single-site expression of nuclear-to-datacenter.

VST.note: Real nuclear fleet (Comanche Peak) but gas-heavy generation mix dilutes theme exposure vs CEG/TLN.

D.sub: Regulated utility w/ nuclear + Virginia DC load
D.note: Regulated utility at the epicenter of Virginia data-center load; nuclear is a small, rate-based slice — lowest-specificity operator.

SMR.note: SPECULATIVE: only NRC-certified SMR design; ENTRA1/TVA program talks up to 6 GW — none of it revenue yet. Optionality sleeve.

OKLO.note: SPECULATIVE: broke ground at INL (2025-09); DOE pilot darling; pre-revenue, dilution certain. Optionality sleeve.
